description: Source code for the AndroidAutogenerator class, which manages code generation tasks for Android projects within the IDE, including generating BuildConfig, AAPT, AIDL, and RenderScript files.

classes.name: AptAutogenerationItem
classes.description: Data class representing information needed for generating APT files, including package name, output directory, and file-to-package mappings.

classes.name: IdlAutogenerationItem
classes.description: Data class representing information for generating Java files from IDL files, including target platform, output paths, source roots, and package name.

classes.name: RenderscriptAutogenerationItem
classes.description: Data class for RenderScript code generation, including SDK location, target, and directories for generated and raw files.

classes.name: BuildconfigAutogenerationItem
classes.description: Data class for BuildConfig generation, including package name and source root path.

methods.name: toRun
methods.description: Determines if autogeneration should run based on mode, facet, and force flag.

methods.name: supportsAutogeneration
methods.description: Checks if the given AndroidFacet supports autogeneration (excludes Gradle projects).

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main entry point to run autogeneration tasks for a given mode, facet, and context, handling obsolete files cleanup.

methods.name: runBuildConfigGenerator
methods.description: Generates the BuildConfig class based on the project's manifest and properties.

methods.name: runAapt
methods.description: Generates resource classes and other files using AAPT, handling file overwrites and cleanup.

methods.name: generateStubClasses
methods.description: Creates stub Java classes with specified class names in the output directory.

methods.name: generateStubClass
methods.description: Creates a single stub Java class file with a given package, class name, and content.

methods.name: patchAndMarkGeneratedFile
methods.description: Prepends header to generated files and marks them as autogenerated.

methods.name: removeAllFilesWithSameName
methods.description: Deletes duplicate files with the same name in the target directory to avoid conflicts.

methods.name: runAidl
methods.description: Generates Java classes from AIDL files, handling file permissions and cleanup.

methods.name: runRenderscript
methods.description: Generates RenderScript Java files and associated resources, handling dependencies and cleanup.

methods.name: ensureFilesWritable
methods.description: Checks and ensures that files are writable before modification.

methods.name: removeDuplicateClasses
methods.description: Removes duplicate class files from the project to prevent conflicts.
